name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is a cloud access security broker and SaaS security platform for discovering cloud use, investigating activities and alerts, governing applications, and applying threat and information-protection controls.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft's supported API exposes tenant-wide security activities, alerts, entities, discovery data, files, IP ranges, and remediation. Relay mounts no connection or runtime tools until it supports customer-tenant application-context onboarding, strict tenant API-origin binding, and a reviewed minimized security-data contract.

blocked.label: Connect Defender for Cloud Apps
blocked.description: Relay does not yet provision the customer-tenant application context and tenant API-origin binding required for this privileged security API.

blocked.label: Read cloud security data
blocked.description: Activities, alerts, entities, discovery reports, files, OAuth-app governance, IP ranges, and security configuration remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Defender for Cloud Apps
blocked.description: Alert disposition, subnet changes, discovery uploads, block scripts, governance actions, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Relay supports customer-tenant application-context consent, tenant API-origin binding, and a bounded security-data contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Defender for Cloud Apps connection or tools are mounted pending customer-tenant application-context onboarding and tenant API-origin binding.
No Defender for Cloud Apps connection or tools are mounted pending customer-tenant application-context onboarding and tenant API-origin binding.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft recommends application context for unattended Defender for Cloud Apps integrations. That flow requires a customer-tenant Entra enterprise application, administrator-approved security permissions, a customer tenant ID, and a tenant-specific API origin discovered in the Defender portal. Relay does not yet have a customer-tenant application-context provisioning and origin-binding contract, and the documented user-context sample uses the password grant that Microsoft explicitly does not recommend for production.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Defender for Cloud Apps unavailable until Relay implements reviewed customer-tenant application-context onboarding, administrator consent verification, strict allowlisting of the discovered tenant API origin, encrypted tenant binding, and a bounded redacted read contract with disconnect and post-disconnect denial tests.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents tenant-specific API origins, activities, alerts, entities, files, discovery and subnet operations, a 100-item response maximum, and a 30-request-per-minute tenant throttle.
Microsoft documents OAuth access and recommends application context for background services and daemons.
Microsoft documents customer-tenant administrator consent, application permissions, client-credential tokens, and per-tenant approval for multi-tenant applications.

Microsoft documents delegated Investigation.read with administrator consent, but its user-context token sample uses username/password and explicitly recommends more secure production authentication flows.
